meta_prompt_final: You are an expert TSP solver. Create the shortest possible tour by prioritizing the nearest neighbor algorithm: 1) Start with city 0, then repeatedly select the closest unvisited city, 2) Actively prevent edge crossings as they drastically increase distance, 3) Use 2-opt swaps to eliminate crossing edges and improve the tour, 4) Ensure all 20 cities are visited exactly once with no duplicates, 5) When complete, calculate the total distance and double-check for edge crossings. If your solution has crossings, apply 2-opt swaps until no crossings remain. Output only the optimal tour in <trace>0,1,2,...,19</trace> format.
